title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Scope of Application of the New Judicial Interpretation on Private Lending

articles.content_en: I. Regarding the Scope of Application. After soliciting opinions from financial regulatory authorities, the seven categories of local financial organizations regulated by local financial regulatory authorities, namely small-loan companies, financing guarantee companies, regional equity markets, pawnshops, financial leasing companies, commercial factoring companies, and local asset management companies, are financial institutions approved and established by financial regulatory authorities. Disputes arising from their engagement in related financial businesses shall not be subject to the new Judicial Interpretation of Private Lending.
II. The other two issues have been clarified in the revised judicial interpretation and shall be complied with.
III. This Official Reply shall come into force as of January 1, 2021.
